unlabelled_and_generality_review: A.1 includes the intrinsic Hausdorff/countable immersed group, zero algebra, uniqueness of its topology and smooth nested inclusion; no ambient closure or external subgroup theorem.
A.2-A.3 include derivatives along arbitrary horizontal fields, smooth module coefficients, frame equivariance, coordinate independence and the r+s+2 bracket bound with the correct curvature factor.

A.4 uses a genuine shrinking neighbourhood basis, arbitrary connected smaller neighbourhoods and smooth restriction inclusions. A.5 proves algebraic linear-span and group generation at all reachable frames.
B.1 includes rank zero, persistent basis across whole fibres, smooth Gram coefficients and invertible continuous-piecewise-time matrix ODE. Both local and global statements are proved.

B.2 uses complete earlier analytic ODE proofs, proves the scalar identity principle internally, and continues every jet separately on an interval; it does not assume a common radius for infinitely many Taylor series.

B.3 proves semicontinuity, stability and closed nowhere-dense singular sets, with the correct containment. C proves the rectangle laboratory, temporary finite-jet plateau, all-order-flat example and distant-curvature counterexample.

D supplies continuous path/square lifting and fundamental-group injectivity, sheet topology, separation, second countability, smoothness, path connectedness and simple connectedness. Deck action and arbitrary, possibly nonnormal, subgroup covers and their universal property are proved.

E passes between continuous and piecewise smooth path classes, proves the inverse transport homomorphism and frame conjugacy, and constructs the simply connected horizontal product section. The representation quotient has explicit Hausdorff/countable smooth charts and a descended flat connection. Both classification directions include disconnected groups and nonclosed image.

F.1 proves pullback transport from the connection form and realizes every subgroup of the monodromy image without normality. F.2 proves the circle fundamental group, general circle conjugacy classification, nontrivial sign double cover and associated Mobius line. F.3 proves the torus fundamental group, arbitrary commuting pairs, all circle classes and exact integer identifications, including transport signs.
